```{r}
#| label: publications
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

source("R/parse_bib.R")

# cv_source/bibliocv.bib is the same file the LaTeX CV cites, so adding a paper there

entries <- parse_bib("cv_source/bibliocv.bib")
cat(render_publications(entries, highlight = "Vaiano"))
```
